sentences.en: Two men came to Juha while he was a judge.

sentences.ar: قال جحا: وإنت كمان معك حق.
sentences.en: Juha said: and you are also right.

sentences.ar: قالت: ما بصير التنين على حق!
sentences.en: She said: they cannot both be right!

sentences.ar: قال جحا: وإنتِ كمان معك حق.
sentences.en: Juha said: and you are right too.
